headline: Marginal angle but clean sheltered winds — worth a morning look.
today: South swell is the wrong angle for the inlet but there's size to it and the wind is friendly, light at dawn going cross-off. That combo can make the sheltered corner work better than it reads on paper. Log or groveler on the morning, don't expect much shape.

daysToWatch.note: Better size to 2.7ft with WSW cross-off all morning keeping it clean. Best window of the week here, go early.
W offshore all day but only knee-high. Clean and rideable if you're desperate, otherwise flat.
